name: general-lsp
description: Attach any language server to any file, configured like nvim-lspconfig.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace-level server definitions are ignored in untrusted workspaces because they run arbitrary commands.

commands.title: Reload Settings and Restart All Servers

generalLsp.extraPaths.markdownDescription: Directories searched after `PATH` for server and formatter commands, e.g. `["~/.local/share/nvim/mason/bin"]`. Also appended to the processes' `PATH`.

generalLsp.formatters.markdownDescription: Command-line formatters keyed by name, like conform.nvim. Every formatter matching a file runs in settings order, each fed the previous one's output. Files with a matching formatter never use LSP formatting.

command.markdownDescription: Executable and arguments, e.g. `["stylua", "--stdin-filepath", "${file}", "-"]`. Supports `${file}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasename}`, `${root}`, `${rootName}`, `${userHome}` and a leading `~`.

languages.markdownDescription: VS Code language IDs to format.

filePatterns.markdownDescription: Glob patterns matched against the file path; a bare `*.gleam` means `**/*.gleam`.

rootMarkers.markdownDescription: Markers locating the working directory (`${root}`), same rules as servers. Defaults to the workspace folder, then the file's directory.

requireRoot.markdownDescription: Skip this formatter when no root marker is found (conform's `require_cwd`).

stdin.markdownDescription: Feed the text on stdin and read the result from stdout. When `false`, `${file}` is a temporary sibling copy that the formatter rewrites in place.

generalLsp.servers.markdownDescription: Language servers keyed by name. Each server attaches to documents matching `languages` or `filePatterns`.

enabled.markdownDescription: Set to `false` to turn the server off but keep its config; see **General LSP: Enable/Disable Server…**.

command.markdownDescription: Executable and arguments, e.g. `["rust-analyzer"]` or `["typescript-language-server", "--stdio"]`. A leading `~` and `${userHome}` expand to the home directory; `${root}` and `${rootName}` to the resolved root and its basename.

languages.markdownDescription: VS Code language IDs to attach to, e.g. `["rust"]`.

filePatterns.markdownDescription: Glob patterns matched against the file path, for files VS Code has no language for, e.g. `["**/*.zig", "**/*.zon"]`.

rootMarkers.markdownDescription: File or directory names (globs allowed, e.g. `*.csproj`) marking the project root, in priority order; a nested array groups markers of equal priority. Without markers the workspace folder is the root.

singleFileSupport.markdownDescription: Attach even when no root marker is found, using the workspace folder or the file's directory as root.

settings.markdownDescription: Served to `workspace/configuration` requests and sent via `workspace/didChangeConfiguration`.

initializationOptions.markdownDescription: Passed verbatim as `initializationOptions` in the `initialize` request.

env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the server process. Values support the same variables as `command`.

fallbackRoot.markdownDescription: Root for files where no root marker is found, instead of the workspace folder or file's directory. Created if missing. Useful to stop a server indexing the parent of a scratch file.

disabledCapabilities.markdownDescription: Server capabilities to strip from the `initialize` result, e.g. `["codeActionProvider"]`, like setting `client.server_capabilities.X = false` in `on_init`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Format only files no `generalLsp.formatters` entry matches.
Format its files even when a CLI formatter matches, and win over other servers.
Never use this server for formatting.
format.markdownDescription: How this server's formatter competes with `generalLsp.formatters`, like conform's `lsp_format`.

venv.markdownDescription: Launch the server as if the nearest Python virtualenv were activated: `VIRTUAL_ENV` set, its `bin` first on `PATH` (also used to resolve `command`). `true` searches the root and its parents for `.venv`, `venv`, `env`; an array gives other folder names. Roots with different venvs never share a process.

multiRoot.markdownDescription: Add newly found roots to a running client as workspace folders (when the server supports it) instead of starting another process. `false` gives nvim's default: one client per root.

scripts.build: bun run build:ext && bun run build:web && bun run build:assets
scripts.watch: bun run build:assets && (bun run build:ext --watch & bun run build:web --watch)
scripts.package: bun run build:ext --minify && bun run build:web --minify && bun run build:assets && vsce package --no-dependencies
